SELECT jj.JM_CD , jj.KOSCOM_CD , jj.JJ_FNM , jj.JJ_NM , jj.JJ_ENM , jj.BALH_CO , jj.WOOS_ILBAN_GB , jj.CHG_GB , jj.NEW_OLD_GB , jj.DANC_GB , jj.BALH_GA , TO_CHAR(jj.KWEONRI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS kweonri_ymd , TO_CHAR(jj.SANGJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sangj_ymd , jj.SANGJ_JUSU , jj.UPJ_CD , TO_CHAR(jj.CREATED_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created_ymd , NVL(jj.DEL_YN, '0') AS del_yn , jb.BALH_NM , uj.UPJ_FNM , jj.CAPSIZE , jj.KOSPIGUBUN , TO_CHAR(jj.WOOS_VOTE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS woos_vote_ymd , jj.UNDER , jb.BALH_NATION , TO_CHAR(jj.BAED_GISAN_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS baed_gisan_ymd , jj.ISIN_CD , jj.A0231 , jj.deposit , jj.CHG_RT FROM SJM0JJ jj LEFT JOIN sjx0jb jb ON jb.BALH_CO = jj.BALH_CO LEFT JOIN szx0uj uj ON uj.UPJ_CD = jj.UPJ_CD WHERE NVL(jj.danc_gb, ' ') != 'X'
AND (jj.jm_cd LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR jj.koscom_cd LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR jj.jj_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY jj.KOSCOM_CD ASC

SELECT jj.JM_CD , jj.KOSCOM_CD , jj.JJ_FNM , jj.JJ_NM , jj.JJ_ENM , jj.BALH_CO , jj.WOOS_ILBAN_GB , jj.CHG_GB , jj.NEW_OLD_GB , jj.DANC_GB , jj.BALH_GA , TO_CHAR(jj.KWEONRI_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS kweonri_ymd , TO_CHAR(jj.SANGJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sangj_ymd , jj.SANGJ_JUSU , jj.UPJ_CD , TO_CHAR(jj.CREATED_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created_ymd , NVL(jj.DEL_YN, '0') AS del_yn , jb.BALH_NM , uj.UPJ_FNM , jj.CAPSIZE , jj.KOSPIGUBUN , TO_CHAR(jj.WOOS_VOTE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS woos_vote_ymd , jj.UNDER , jb.BALH_NATION , TO_CHAR(jj.BAED_GISAN_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS baed_gisan_ymd , jj.ISIN_CD , jj.A0231 , jj.deposit , jj.CHG_RT FROM SJM0JJ jj LEFT JOIN sjx0jb jb ON jb.BALH_CO = jj.BALH_CO LEFT JOIN szx0uj uj ON uj.UPJ_CD = jj.UPJ_CD WHERE jj.danc_gb = 'X'
AND (jj.jm_cd LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR jj.koscom_cd LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR jj.jj_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY jj.KOSCOM_CD ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SJM0JJ WHERE jm_cd = #{jmCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SJM0JJ ( jm_cd, koscom_cd, jj_fnm, jj_nm, jj_enm, balh_co, woos_ilban_gb, chg_gb, new_old_gb, danc_gb, balh_ga, kweonri_ymd, sangj_ymd, sangj_jusu, upj_cd, created_ymd, del_yn, capsize, kospigubun, woos_vote_ymd, under, baed_gisan_ymd, isin_cd, a0231, deposit, chg_rt ) VALUES ( #{jmCd}, #{koscomCd}, #{jjFnm}, #{jjNm}, #{jjEnm}, #{balhCo}, #{woosIlbanGb}, #{chgGb}, #{newOldGb}, #{dancGb}, #{balhGa}, TO_DATE(#{kweonriYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, TO_DATE(#{sangjYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, #{sangjJusu}, #{upjCd}, SYSDATE, NVL(#{delYn}, '0'), #{capsize}, #{kospigubun}, TO_DATE(#{woosVoteYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, #{under}, TO_DATE(#{baedGisanYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, #{isinCd}, #{a0231}, #{deposit}, #{chgRt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SJM0JJ SET koscom_cd = #{koscomCd}, jj_fnm = #{jjFnm}, jj_nm = #{jjNm}, jj_enm = #{jjEnm}, balh_co = #{balhCo}, woos_ilban_gb = #{woosIlbanGb}, chg_gb = #{chgGb}, new_old_gb = #{newOldGb}, danc_gb = #{dancGb}, balh_ga = #{balhGa}, kweonri_ymd = TO_DATE(#{kweonriYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, sangj_ymd = TO_DATE(#{sangjYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, sangj_jusu = #{sangjJusu}, upj_cd = #{upjCd}, del_yn = NVL(#{delYn}, '0'), capsize = #{capsize}, kospigubun = #{kospigubun}, woos_vote_ymd = TO_DATE(#{woosVoteYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, under = #{under}, baed_gisan_ymd = TO_DATE(#{baedGisanYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, isin_cd = #{isinCd}, a0231 = #{a0231}, deposit = #{deposit}, chg_rt = #{chgRt} WHERE jm_cd = #{jmCd}
